screening_decisions.reason: RCT of elderly depressed outpatients who responded to antidepressants and completed continuation therapy, randomized to placebo, nortriptyline, or phenelzine for 1-year maintenance treatment. Meets all criteria: RCT design, elderly population, responders randomized to maintenance antidepressant treatment.
Scale development/validation study, not an RCT of continuation or maintenance treatment for depression.
Psychometric validation study of a therapy rating scale, not an RCT of depression treatment.
Narrative review article discussing assessment and management of psychiatric problems in oldest old, not an RCT.
Systematic review using NNT analysis, not a primary RCT of continuation/maintenance treatment.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of observational cohort/case-control studies examining vascular risk factors and depression association, not an RCT of treatment.
Long-term follow-up of an RCT, but abstract does not specify that participants were aged 60 or over. Population age criterion not met.

RCT of older community residents (aged 65+) who responded to open sertraline treatment, then randomized to double-blind sertraline vs placebo for continuation/maintenance over ~2 years. Meets all criteria.
Narrative review of neuropsychological findings in late-life depression, not an RCT.
RCT of persons aged 70+ with major depression who responded to acute treatment, randomized to maintenance paroxetine vs placebo and IPT vs clinical management. Meets all criteria.
Pilot RCT of adults aged 60+ who had major depression in previous year, randomized to CBT-G plus antidepressant vs antidepressant alone for maintenance/recurrence prevention. Meets all criteria.
Conceptual paper proposing definitions for remission, recovery, relapse, and recurrence. Not an RCT.
RCT of elderly patients with recurrent major depression randomized to two fixed plasma levels of nortriptyline for 3-year maintenance treatment. Meets all criteria.
RCT of out-patients aged 65+ with unipolar major depression who responded to citalopram, then randomized to citalopram vs placebo for maintenance therapy (48+ weeks). Meets all criteria.
RCT of acute and maintenance treatment, but abstract does not specify that participants were aged 60 or over. Population age criterion not met.
Development and reliability study of an assessment instrument (GMS), not an RCT of treatment.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis techniques for survival outcomes in cancer studies, not related to depression treatment in older adults.
RCT comparing MBCT with maintenance antidepressants, but recruits 'adult patients' without specifying age 60+. Population age criterion not met.

RCT of patients aged 70+ with major depression who responded to initial treatment, randomized to maintenance paroxetine vs placebo and psychotherapy vs clinical management for 2 years. Meets all criteria.
Systematic overview of RCTs of antidepressant continuation, not a primary RCT. Additionally, does not focus specifically on older adults aged 60+.

Secondary analysis of an RCT (Reynolds et al., 2006) evaluating maintenance IPT vs clinical management in remitted depressed elderly patients. Analyzes data from eligible RCT of maintenance treatment in older adults.
Review/commentary article discussing psychotherapy for depression in older people, not an RCT.
Cochrane systematic review examining efficacy of antidepressant classes in elderly, not a primary RCT.
Observational population-based study of antidepressant prescribing patterns, not an RCT.

RCT of elderly subjects remitted from major depression who received continuation nortriptyline, then randomized to nortriptyline maintenance vs placebo for up to 2 years. Examines executive dysfunction as predictor of outcome. Meets all criteria.
Cochrane systematic review of psychotherapeutic treatments, not a primary RCT.
Prospective observational cohort study examining relationship between depressive symptoms and functional disability, not an RCT of treatment.
Expert panel-informed literature review of community-based interventions, not an RCT.

RCT of older adults aged 65+ with recently remitted major depression, randomized to maintenance antidepressant plus donepezil vs maintenance antidepressant plus placebo for 2 years. Meets all criteria.
Methodological paper describing recruitment strategies for a dietary intervention trial, not related to depression maintenance treatment.

RCT of patients older than 59 years (average age 67, one-third aged 70+) with recurrent major depression who recovered after acute treatment, randomized to maintenance nortriptyline, IPT, combination, or placebo. Meets all criteria.
Paper describing development of a depression rating scale, not an RCT of treatment.

RCT of acute treatment (CBT vs TAU vs talking control) in older people with depression, not a continuation/maintenance trial after successful treatment. Patients were randomized at baseline with active depression.
Development and validation of a therapy rating scale to discriminate between maintenance IPT and medication clinic, not an RCT of treatment outcomes.
